verdicts.evidence: The file open in s1 gates the POST at f1:59: only a successful open supplies the file for upload, while failure skips it through the exception handler. This is a data_availability gate in CustomInstall.run, registered as the install command at f1:79.

The try block in s2 uploads the file only when its open succeeds; an open failure reaches the bare exception handler and bypasses the POST. This is a data_availability gate deciding file exfiltration in the registered install command (f1:79).
